sloka: व्यवसायं च तं बुद्ध्वा स होवाच महागिरिः ।पुत्रेति मधुरां वाणीं मनः प्रह्लादयन्निव ।। ५.५८.१२ ।।।।
transliteration: vyavasāyaṁ ca taṁ buddhvā sa hovāca mahāgiriḥ ।putreti madhurāṁ vāṇīṁ manaḥ prahlādayanniva ।। 5.58.12 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Know me to be a friend of windgod and so I am like your father's brother. I am dwelling in this great ocean and known as Mainaka.
